title: AI Quantitative Trading
author: Ail886
selftext:
Hello everyone, I am Aileen 👋

I am from Hong Kong, currently in India diving deep into Financial Engineering.

Recently, I have been getting into Quantitative Trading and truly feel that trading is going through an "evolution" — the future definitely belongs to algorithms and data 🤖

Compared to emotional and subjective judgments, I put more trust in "numbers" and "logic."

That’s why I started this account — to use Reddit to record my upcoming quantitative gold trading practical data.

Here, I will periodically share:

✅ Daily performance statistics of XAU/USD

✅ Optimization and backtesting insights of EA strategies

✅ Some thoughts on trading psychology and risk management

This is not some get-rich-quick secret; it’s simply a trader’s self-improvement record 📒

If you’re also interested in quant trading or gold trading, feel free to join the discussion below 👇
